note: Source of truth for prompts. Seeded to the database by `pnpm db:seed`. Ids are derived from the text, so re-seeding is idempotent and a prompt keeps its identity across environments. Change the text and you create a new prompt rather than silently rewriting one two people already answered.

core.label: Everyday

What are you quietly worried about?
Describe today in one photograph you did not take.
What would a perfectly ordinary good day together look like?
What do you want to be better at by next year?
Which of our plans are you most impatient for?
What do you think I am wrong about?
When did you last feel proud of yourself?
What is a smell that takes you straight back somewhere?
What is something you have never told anyone?
Who did you become because of someone else?
What is the kindest thing a stranger has done for you?

distance.label: Apart
prompts: What is the first thing you want to do when we are in the same room?
What is the hardest hour of the day to be apart?
What have you seen this week that you wished I was there for?
What do you picture when you picture me right now?
What is something about your day I would never guess?
What would you show me first if I turned up tomorrow?
What has been easier about being apart than you expected?
What do you save up to tell me?

intimate.label: Just us
prompts: What do you think about that you have never said out loud?
When did you last feel most wanted by me?
What would you like more of, and have not asked for?
What is something you want to try?
What makes you feel closest to me, outside of a bedroom?
What is a moment between us you keep going back to?
